name: threadmoth
description: Deterministic, source-preserving mutation for AI coding agents.

interface.longDescription: Use Threadmoth when an AI coding agent needs an exact, bounded workspace mutation with ambiguity handling, stale-state protection, and a machine-readable certificate. Preserve user ambiguity when shaping requests: narrow from evidence, never from imagination. The local threadmoth executable is required on PATH.
defaultPrompt: Make this bounded file change and preserve unrelated bytes.
Preview this exact workspace mutation before applying it.
Explain the mutation certificate or refusal.
